note: Candidate Summa-UI Web rules W01 to W10. Not approved, not numbered into the P series: the owner decides numbering and whether Web is a profile. Evidence FB-0052 to FB-0057.

principles.title: Structured Asymmetry
principles.summary: One column grid, deliberately unequal compositions: cards differ in width, height, weight and surface, edges stay on the grid, a feature insert lets content flow beside it and reclaim the width beneath it.
rules: Asymmetry is intentional, never random gaps.
Not a regular grid with unequal cards: use row spanning so content flows around an insert.
Do not reserve an empty column for a small insert.
Keep a sensible reading order and a deliberate mobile order.
Never in a primary object workspace or dense tool.

principles.title: Rectangular Surfaces
principles.summary: Square or subtly rounded corners, purpose built cards, hierarchy by surface step, type and whitespace.
rules: 2px to 8px corners; no pill containers.
One card design per kind of content, not one generic card.
Share behaviour, allow compositional difference; avoid components with dozens of flags.

principles.title: Charcoal, Emerald and Warm
principles.summary: Charcoal is the foundation, emerald means action and progress, a warm palette means editorial, educational and historical material and featured surfaces.
rules: Emerald and warm are not interchangeable.
Not every card is coloured; a warm surface is an insert, never the page.
Text on warm is ink; focus on warm is a dark ring.
Needs an explicit decision against P06.

principles.title: Web Typography
principles.summary: Two self hosted faces and a scale with roles: display, title, section, card, body, support, metadata, eyebrow, editorial.
rules: Functional sans for navigation, controls, tools and body.
Editorial serif for the wordmark, editorial headings, features and educational or historical content, never in a dense tool.
No third party font fetch; few families and weights.

principles.title: Action Hierarchy
principles.summary: Actions look like what they are: primary, secondary, tertiary, ink, outline, icon only, destructive, branded integration.
rules: One dominant primary per region.
Tertiary is a quiet text action with an arrow.
Ink is the solid dark action for light or warm surfaces.
Not every action is emerald or a charcoal rectangle with a chevron.

principles.title: Restrained Focus and Hover
principles.summary: Subtle hover, focus-visible rings of 1px to 1.5px at 3:1 against the surface, a dark ring on warm surfaces.
rules: Pointer interaction never draws a large ring.
No thick or emerald rings, glows, expanding borders or nested outlines.
Validate focus contrast on charcoal and on warm surfaces.

principles.title: Selection Without a Stripe
principles.summary: A selected navigation item or card is a surface step and heavier type, with no coloured left stripe.
rules: Settles the P03 reading for selection.

principles.title: Third Party Identity
principles.summary: A third party entry may use a light surface and its mark where terms permit, without decorative labels or claims of partnership.
rules: No label that only says third party.
No wording implying partnership or endorsement without one.
The mark is shown as supplied.

principles.title: Real Imagery
principles.summary: Imagery is meaningful to the content; nothing is fabricated to fill an empty state.
rules: No unrelated stock photography.
Empty states are deliberate and consistent.

principles.title: Deliberate Responsive Composition
principles.summary: Desktop, tablet and mobile are designed, not collapsed.
rules: Main content before supporting features on mobile where it serves the task.
Local navigation becomes a compact selector.
No horizontal overflow; touch targets follow the approved rule.
